title: Quick Italian Green Bean Stracciatella Pasta
description: A simple, yet flavorful pasta dish featuring sautéed green beans and stracciatella cheese.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the green beans and sauté for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Stir in the stracciatella cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the green bean and cheese mixture.
Toss to combine and serve immediately.
Grate additional stracciatella cheese on top, if desired.
